name: threadmesh-desktop-probe
description: Developer-only desktop hook probe. No messaging, chat access or automatic wake.

interface.shortDescription: Check native session hooks; not a collaboration integration.
interface.longDescription: Emits a fingerprint of the current hook session into that same session. Does not read transcripts, store events, send messages or wake other sessions. Requires Node on PATH. Developer preflight only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Report the ThreadMesh desktop probe marker if one is present; do not invent it.
